decision: User authorized family-only wording transfer on 2026-10-05.
allocation: Three new controlled notes for each of nine inspected recordings. Preserve the same six propositions, numerical facts and reference verdicts, nine atomic assertions and twelve generic sentence candidates per note. No fresh measurements, downloads, protected-panel access or independent reports.
text_design: Plain paraphrases, logical negation and boundary-focused wording. Include eligibility qualifiers, inherited positive/negative numerical claims, local pronouns, recorded-count versus explicit-health claims, endorsed causes, requested checks, questions, explicitly unendorsed reported allegations, two-assertion compounds and ambiguous subjects. Swap intact antecedent blocks by stable note-id hash. No arbitrary span extraction or compound splitting. New prose and references freeze before inference; designed by the same assistant after inspecting earlier failures.
treatments: For each new note, baseline uses original v2 definitions and meaning changes only shared kind to the exact previously tested MEANING constant. No revised role definition. Questions, options, service/channel inventories, observations, numerical policy, quarantine and 0.70 boundaries stay fixed. Both arms see identical new prose. Whole shared state is visible to every question.
definition: Map the single assertion family from the written property, not telemetry truth or operational implications. Both a defined positive property and its opposite belong to the same family; polarity is classified separately. metric_material compares eligible absolute scaled metric change with exactly 3.0 (at least or below); metric_direction compares eligible signed metric change with zero (greater than zero or zero/negative). The eligibility qualifier belongs to this bounded policy property. duration_material compares eligible absolute relative duration change with exactly 25% (at least or below). span_adequacy concerns at least five recorded spans in EACH window, or a window below five. A sentence about recorded span counts is span_adequacy; it does not assert service health. health requires an explicit assertion that a service is healthy or unhealthy, including "That service is healthy". Do not turn a count or numerical change into a health assertion. causality asserts that a service caused or did not cause the incident. Use unmapped for other thresholds, non-assertions or multiple assertion families. A sentence asserting both incident origin and service health has multiple families, even for one subject.
failure_handling: Validate model, answer envelope, usage and context globally. Wrong model, unexpected answer fields, invalid global shape/usage/context, HTTP or network error stops the run. Missing or malformed individual answers quarantine their entire sentence, including an invalid unused dimension; independently valid siblings remain eligible. Keep raw invalid choices. Never choose argmax, invent probabilities, retry or repair. Apply the same per-sentence policy to dependent verdict replies. A globally valid reply with quarantined sentences is completed work with lost sentence coverage, not a successful judgment of those sentences.
acceptance: Frozen sentence-level quarantine and strict Choice normalization. Require one mapped assertion, unique observed service, mapped polarity and relevant channel/measure, with every required probability >=0.70. All fields must validate, including unused dimensions. Verdict display also requires >=0.70. No threshold search or repairs.
verdict: After actual extraction replies, frozen code constructs one bound-batch request per note/arm/round from accepted text and assigned services. Retain full note and only ledgers of accepted subjects. Use unchanged numerical policy/Choice verdict criteria. Do not correct model bindings with annotations. Freeze exact dependent requests and extraction evidence fingerprint in a separate committed protocol before those calls. Zero accepted candidates yields an explicit application skip, not a fabricated reply. Verdict display requires accepted extraction and chosen verdict probability >=0.70; probabilities are not calibrated risk estimates.
execution: Commit all producers and plan before preparing new note bytes. Commit exact extraction fingerprints before 162 once-only extraction calls: 27 notes, two inputs, three rounds. Commit actual bindings, extraction summary and exact dependent requests before at most 162 verdict calls. Rotate notes and input orders each round. Maximum 11664 extraction plus 1944 verdict answers. No retries, warmups, text repairs, threshold fitting or candidate substitution.
scoring: Report role agreement over all 108 sentence candidates; assertion precision/recall; service and exact kind/polarity/relevant channel/measure over 54 routable gold claims; accepted correct bindings, missed claims, accepted nonclaims/review-only claims; conditional verdict accuracy on correctly bound claims; end-to-end correctness requires correct extraction AND verdict, never a coincidentally correct verdict on the wrong service; whole-six note accuracy and displayed coverage. Review-only ambiguous/compound atomic claims are disclosed outside the six-routable verdict denominator. Preserve every gold claim, including withheld or missing. Show rounds and applications separately, paired losses from annotated control, consistency and actual costs. Report each application, wording and round separately as well as all-wording panels; 27 notes and 486 per-arm repeated routable opportunities are not independent recordings. Fresh baseline/meaning comparison only; historical scores remain labeled context.
research_gate: Meaning-only is the sole candidate. In each application, wording and round, require inherited absolute >=90% role/service/meaning/accepted-correct/end-to-end/whole-six coverage, complete calls, zero accepted review-only/nonclaims/wrong bindings or unsafe displays, and >=half supported-display coverage. Also lose no role/service/meaning/accepted-correct/end-to-end count against contemporary baseline. Both all-wording and every wording panel must pass. Passing unlocks no protected telemetry or deployment.
limits: New wording transfer on inspected measurements, not held-out incidents or independent reports. Three fault groups, assistant-authored notes/annotations and public pretraining exposure unknown. Logical phrasing is annotated under the bounded numerical taxonomy. No authentic-report, specialist-review, causal or operational reliability claim.
